content: @react-three/fiber 9.7.0 is current stable. Full React 19.2 support. For Next.js App Router: must use dynamic(() => import('./HeroScene'), { ssr: false }) inside a 'use client' component since WebGL needs browser. Performance: frameloop='demand' for static scenes, PerformanceMonitor for adaptive quality, performance.regress() during interaction. Bundles own reconciler since React 19 to avoid version conflicts.
